mapper.sql: select a.access_id, a.plate_number, a.driver_name, a.driver_name_en, a.out_time, a.in_time, a.operator_name, a.operator_name_en, a.apply_id, a.vehicle_id, ca.apply_no, ca.is_urgent, a.del_flag, a.create_by, a.create_time, a.update_by, a.update_time, a.remark from car_access_record a left join car_apply ca on ca.apply_id = a.apply_id
mapper.select: where a.plate_number = #{plateNumber} and a.del_flag = '0' order by a.create_time desc limit 1
mapper.update: update car_access_record set del_flag = '2' where access_id = #{accessId}
